faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: If your case is not here, message us on WhatsApp and we will look at it with you.

volume.a: We handle everything from personal purchases and loose cargo to full containers. The minimum depends on the route and the mode of transport.

customs.a: Yes. We coordinate documentation, classification and customs clearance at origin and destination through to cargo release.

transit.q: How long does a shipment take?
transit.a: It depends on the corridor and the mode chosen. With your quote we give the estimated transit range and clearance times.

shopper.q: How does the Personal Shopper service work?
shopper.a: You send us the product link or reference, we buy on your behalf at US retailers, consolidate and ship to your country.

tracking.a: Yes. We report the status at every milestone: pickup, departure, arrival, customs and delivery.
